items.title: Fix missing data after saving a time slice as .rrd
items.body:
## Related
* Closes https://github.com/rerun-io/rerun/issues/12236


## What
The previous code had two enormous bugs:

* Static chunks were always dropped
* Chunks spanning over the entire selected range were ignored

So a lot of chunks were missing in the results 🤦

items.title: Allow specifying widths of `BarChart` bars
items.body: ### Related * Closes #6265 * (Should) close #4764 ### What Adds an optional `widths` component to the `BarChart` archetype. Uses this when rendering the `BarChart` in the viewer. items.title: Introduce deep Chunk slicing
Implement ChunkStore and integrate it everywhere
items.body:
Implements the new chunk store and integrates it all over the place.

The highest-level query APIs and caches are unchanged -- for now.

- Fixes https://github.com/rerun-io/rerun/issues/6066
- Fixes https://github.com/rerun-io/rerun/issues/4415
- Fixes https://github.com/rerun-io/rerun/issues/442
- Fixes https://github.com/rerun-io/rerun/issues/1894
 
_Requires 0.17 to be branched off of main before merging._
